shape_and_motion.scope: Shared10-beta/scale and all300 body/root/translation jointly fitted to all8 surface COCO observations and previously screened21handpoints; fingers/head jaw/eyes inherited as priors. Shape±3 and scale±15percent bounds, weak pose and temporal acceleration priors. Joint fit can absorb detection/calibration errors; input residuals are not independent geometry truth. Zero-beta control uses same motion fitter. Must export through actual LHM dense shape blend and shaped rest rig and rerender before adoption; object motion not yet refitted and prior helmet attachment is not valid evidence of contact.

actual_lhm_export.scope: Export/replay animation contract verified, not reconstructed motion or novel-view quality validation. Original complete LHM model used during export only; bundle replay requires tensor skinning and saved neural decoder, not reconstruction encoder.

quality_gate.reason: Accept only a reference-connected, mutually consistent response graph; otherwise gains are diagnostic and MUST NOT enter feature fitting.

rejected_camera_correction.scope: Reference camera exactly1; real-image colors at4096 deterministic Gaussian-center candidates over sampled times, fixed support excludes candidate object. Accumulated alpha>.95 and center-to-expected-depth distance<.005 normalized units approximate visibility. Unsaturated sRGB converted to linear, per-frame pair median log ratios, connected graph robust IRLS. Geometry/pose bias and view-dependent lighting remain. No neural rendered colors used to fit gains, no photometric image-quality acceptance; no dynamic selection or heldout-camera validation yet.

scope: Components and unadopted candidates. Nonzero beta is propagated through actual upstream dense LHM shape blend and shaped rest skeleton; canonical query and voxel weights intentionally remain beta-independent as upstream requires. Same fitter zero-beta control has different initialization, so residual difference does not isolate true shape accuracy. Preview reuses OLD helmet motion without refitting: it visibly misaligns with changed head, and is not an accepted combined scene. Color correspondence calibration rejected. No licensed tensors, raw images or camera arrays published.
